definitions.gloss: free-to-play; not spending real money on in-game purchases
definitions.explanation: Describes the practice of playing a mobile or online game without making any real-money purchases, or a player who does so. Contrasts with paying users who buy in-game items or currency.

examples.japanese: {無課金|むかきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦クリア→クリア：10825_kuria⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I cleared it without spending any money.

examples.japanese: {無課金|むかきん}⟦プレイヤー→プレイヤー：15082_pureiyaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a game that even free-to-play players can enjoy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無課金|むかきん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: He's ranked high even though he hasn't spent any money.

notes:
A modern internet and gaming term composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧ (in-app purchase/billing). Widely used in discussions of mobile games and online games with microtransaction models.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無課金|むかきん}⟦プレイヤー→プレイヤー：15082_pureiyaa⟧ — free-to-play player
- {無課金|むかきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{攻略|こうりゃく}する→攻略する：25273_kouryakusuru⟧ — to beat (a game) without paying
- {無課金|むかきん}{勢|ぜい} — the free-to-play crowd

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧ — in-app purchase; paying for game items
- ⟦{微課金|びかきん}→微課金：29819_bikakin⟧ — light spending (small purchases)
- {廃課金|はいかきん} — heavy spending (whale)
- ガチャ — gacha (random item draw mechanic)
